name: Glow Cursor
description: WebGL2 fluid simulation that leaves a glowing, swirling light trail behind the pointer inside a container, with bloom, optional grain and a click burst. Children render on top.
contents: Wrapper div with a full-size WebGL canvas overlay (pointer-events none) and optional children layered above
behavior: Pointer movement inside the container injects glowing dye and velocity into a fluid simulation
Emitter follows the pointer with a spring, so the trail lags and curves
Trail swirls, fades by the linger time and gets a multi-level bloom glow
Click or tap fires a burst of six jets at the pointer
Simulation sleeps and clears when idle, and pauses when off-screen or the tab is hidden
With prefers-reduced-motion, the emitter snaps to the pointer and the fluid motion is skipped so the trail only fades

fixed: Requires WebGL2 and the EXT_color_buffer_float extension, otherwise nothing renders
Wrapper is relative, h-full w-full and overflow hidden, so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer, pointerdown and pointerleave listeners are attached to window and document, not only the container
Quality, theme and most settings are read live, but the WebGL setup runs once on mount
Needs a mouse or pointer hover, so touch devices only get the click burst and drag trail
Uses Tailwind utility classes for the wrapper and canvas
Marked as a client component with 'use client'

options.look: Additive neon light that glows on dark backgrounds, screen blend by default
options.useWhen: The section has a dark or black background

options.look: Soft ink-like colored smoke with normal blending and a whitened hot core
